title: Head of AI & Automation (Solutions Architect)
description:
**Company:**
RFS Business Solutions (Startup)

**Employment Type:**
Work from Office, full-time.

**Location:**
Arch Square, Room 201, EP Block, Sector 5, Kolkata, West Bengal

**Experience:**
7+ Years

**Working Hours:**
Overlap with international clients' working hours

**We are looking for a hands-on Head of AI & Automation to lead our technical operations, design and build client solutions, manage a team of engineers, and establish the technical standards needed to scale our AI business.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Design end-to-end AI automation solutions, including workflows, APIs, data flow, AI models, and human approval processes.
* Select the right tools, platforms, and infrastructure based on project requirements, cost, reliability, and security.
* Build and troubleshoot complex automations, API integrations, LLM applications, and AI voice agents hands-on.
* Review technical designs and workflows before deployment, ensuring quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Investigate production failures, identify root causes, and implement permanent fixes.

**2. AI Development & Deployment**

* Build automations using n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom code.
* Develop AI agents, voice agents, CRM integrations, and LLM-powered applications.
* Manage deployment, testing, monitoring, error handling, and ongoing maintenance.
* Create reusable workflows, templates, prompts, and code components to speed up delivery.
* Optimize AI model selection, API usage, response times, and operating costs.

**3. Team & Project Management**

* Recruit, train, mentor, and manage AI developers and automation engineers.
* Assign tasks, review code and workflows, track delivery, and maintain technical quality standards.
* Establish development SOPs, documentation practices, testing procedures, and deployment guidelines.
* Ensure every client solution is properly documented and can be maintained by multiple team members.

**4. Client Communication**

* Work directly with international clients to understand business requirements and technical challenges.
* Prepare solution designs, project scopes, timelines, estimates, and demonstrations.
* Explain technical concepts in simple language and set realistic expectations.
* Identify technical risks and recommend practical solutions before development begins.

**5. Security & Infrastructure**

* Manage cloud deployments, server infrastructure, credentials, access permissions, and backups.
* Implement secure API integrations, MFA, least-privilege access, and appropriate data protection.
* Protect AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized actions, and excessive API costs.
* Establish monitoring, alerts, incident-response procedures, and recovery plans.

Mandatory Requirements

* 7+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, or automation, including 2+ years building production AI or LLM-powered systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **n8n**
  , plus working knowledge of Make and/or Zapier.
* Excellent knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, error handling, and system integrations.
* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar LLM platforms.
* Practical experience building AI voice agents using Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs, or Twilio.
* Strong proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, SQL, and at least one vector database.
* Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including deployment and infrastructure management.
* Experience with CRM automation using HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or Zoho.
* Knowledge of RAG systems, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, cost optimization, and AI security.
* Proven ability to lead engineers, review technical work, and manage project delivery.
* Excellent English communication, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

**Important:**
We need a hands-on technical leader who can design, build, debug, secure, and maintain production-ready systems—not someone whose experience is limited to project management or basic automation templates. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical technical assessment.

title: Microsoft-CRM Technical-Manager

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Manager Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Manager to lead large‑scale CRM and Power Platform initiatives, drive technical excellence, and manage high‑performing delivery teams. This role combines strategic oversight, architecture leadership, and people management to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that enable business transformation.

* Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery across D365 modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service, with accountability for quality and outcomes.
* Manage and mentor a team of developers, leads, and technical consultants, providing direction, performance feedback, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Oversee development of custom plugins, workflows, integrations, and extensions using C#, JavaScript, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Power Platform technologies.
* Establish and enforce development standards through code reviews, design governance, testing strategies, and solution validation.
* Drive solution scalability, security, and performance by overseeing system architecture, integration patterns, and optimization efforts.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, scope, and resource utilization to ensure on‑time and within‑budget delivery.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration designs, and deployment standards.
* Act as a senior technical advisor to stakeholders, clearly articulating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong leadership experience managing technical teams in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM customization, extensibility, and solution architecture.
* Solid hands‑on understanding of C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and integration patterns (Azure and Power Platform).
* Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise‑scale CRM implementations.
* Strong grasp of Agile delivery models, estimation, planning, and governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills.
* Strategic mindset with strong problem‑solving, decision‑making, and prioritization capabilities.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**
**The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:**

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**<< What we look for>>**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation, with at least 1 year in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, compliance, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.
